news_candidates.summary: NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope, aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket, transits the Sun during launch from the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida on Aug. 30, 2026. Roman is named after the agency’s first chief astronomer. Roman will survey billions of stars and galaxies with a field of view far larger than Hubble’s, […]

news_candidates.title: Rise in Real Yields Has Further to Run, Nuveen Says
news_candidates.title_zh: Nuveen称实际收益率仍有进一步上升空间
news_candidates.summary: The rise in real yields, which is outpacing that of nominal and breakeven rates, has "a little bit more room to run," says Laura Cooper, global investment strategist at Nuveen. "The key catalyst going forward will be that August inflation print," Cooper tells Bloomberg Television. "We're going to be driven more by data in the next coming weeks." (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: Nuveen全球投资策略师劳拉·库珀称，实际收益率涨幅超过名义收益率和盈亏平衡利率，仍有一些上升空间。她表示，8月通胀数据将是关键催化剂，未来数周市场将更多由数据驱动。

news_candidates.title: Israel Faces Rate Dilemma as War Settles and Elections Loom
news_candidates.title_zh: 战事趋稳、选举临近之际，以色列面临利率抉择
news_candidates.summary: Israel’s central bank is set for a close call on interest rates Tuesday, with forecasters evenly split over whether it will cut for a third straight meeting or hold.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 以色列央行周二将面临利率抉择。预测人士对该行是连续第三次降息还是维持利率不变，意见各半。

news_candidates.title: Tim Cook’s parting message: Apple is in the hands of a product builder
news_candidates.title_zh: 库克向苹果员工发布卸任CEO前的最后一封信
news_candidates.summary: Tim Cook’s farewell memo to Apple employees offers a glimpse at how he wants John Ternus to be seen: as a product builder with deep experience across the iPhone, Mac, AirPods, and other major hardware lines.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 蒂姆·库克在给苹果员工的告别信中，将接任者约翰·特纳斯定位为具备iPhone、Mac和AirPods等核心产品经验的产品负责人。

news_candidates.title: Japan’s Finance Chief Plays Down Bessent’s BOJ Rate Hike Push
news_candidates.title_zh: 日本财务大臣淡化贝森特敦促日银加息的说法
news_candidates.summary: Japan’s Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama said that she and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent share the view that their recent joint intervention in the currency market was beneficial, while playing down reports that he has been pushing for the Bank of Japan to raise its policy rate.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 日本财务大臣片山皋月表示，她与美国财长斯科特·贝森特都认为近期联合干预汇市有益，同时淡化了贝森特敦促日本央行上调政策利率的报道。

news_candidates.title: Microsoft Outlook and OpenAI's ChatGPT Work are experiencing user outages
news_candidates.title_zh: 微软Outlook与OpenAI ChatGPT Work出现用户服务中断
news_candidates.summary: OpenAI's ChatGPT Work offering was down for some users on Monday, and Microsoft said it was having issues with Exchange Online.
news_candidates.summary_zh: OpenAI的ChatGPT Work服务周一对部分用户不可用；微软表示其Exchange Online也出现问题。

news_candidates.title: Hugging Face's new duck robot is selling fast. A Chinese chip powers it

news_candidates.summary_zh: Hugging Face旗下法国子公司Pollen Robotics推出的彩色“Microduck”机器人自周四发布以来，销量已超过1万台。

news_candidates.title: Japan Ministries Seek Record Budget as Yields Hit 30-Year High
news_candidates.title_zh: 日本各部门申请创纪录预算，国债收益率升至30年高位
news_candidates.summary: Japan’s ministries requested a record amount of spending for next fiscal year, putting Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi’s fiscal ambitions in sharper focus as the yield on benchmark government bonds touched 3% for the first time in three decades.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 日本各部门为下一财年申请创纪录规模的支出。在基准国债收益率30年来首次触及3%之际，这使首相高市早苗的财政目标更受关注。

news_candidates.title: Gold Extends Drop as Fresh Mideast Tensions Raise Fed Hike Bets
news_candidates.title_zh: 中东紧张局势推升美联储加息预期，黄金延续下跌
news_candidates.summary: Gold fell to the lowest in almost two weeks as fresh hostilities in the Middle East sent oil higher, adding to pressure on the Federal Reserve to lift interest rates.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 黄金跌至近两周低点。中东新一轮冲突推高油价，增加了美联储加息压力。

news_candidates.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’

news_candidates.title: South Korea’s Exports Gather Pace as Chip Boom Powers Ahead
news_candidates.title_zh: 芯片热潮持续推动韩国出口增长加快
news_candidates.summary: South Korea’s exports extended their strong growth in August as artificial-intelligence demand powered chip shipments and the broader economy, giving the central bank little reason to retreat from its newly hawkish stance after back-to-back interest-rate hikes.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 受人工智能需求推动芯片出货及整体经济增长，韩国8月出口延续强劲增长。韩国央行此前连续两次加息后转向鹰派，几乎没有理由退让。

news_candidates.title: UK Shop Price Inflation Hits Two-Year High After Energy Spike

news_candidates.summary_zh: 受中东冲突影响开始传导至超市货架，英国商店价格上月以逾两年来最快速度上涨。

news_candidates.title: House Intelligence Committee warns of 'Black Swan' AI risks

news_candidates.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M

news_candidates.title: Bessent pushes back on Druckenmiller critique of bond intervention

news_candidates.title: New Zealand Set to Raise Rates Again to Counter Inflation Threat

news_candidates.title: India’s Uneven Monsoon Rains Deepen Crop and Inflation Risks

news_candidates.title: Trump says U.S. communities opposing AI data centers could end up 'backwards and poor'

news_candidates.title: AI could cause global economic downturn, Andrew Bailey warns G20

news_candidates.title: Dyson Announces $499 CameraJet Smart Toothbrush With AI, Built-In Camera

news_candidates.title: Anthropic sued over alleged theft of ‘tens of thousands’ of songs
news_candidates.title_zh: 音乐出版商起诉Anthropic涉嫌用版权歌曲训练Claude
news_candidates.summary: AI company faces multibillion dollar lawsuit over misuse of copyrighted songs to train Claude models All AI wants for Christmas is a vast back catalogue of songs without paying for it, according to a multibillion-dollar lawsuit against the startup behind the Claude chatbot. Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell, music publishers who manage the copyright of songs on behalf of songwriters and composers, are seeking damages for alleged misuse of “tens of thousands” of copyrighted works by Anthropic. Continue reading...
news_candidates.summary_zh: 索尼音乐出版和华纳Chappell等音乐出版商起诉Anthropic，指控其未经授权使用数万首版权歌曲训练Claude，并寻求数十亿美元赔偿。

news_candidates.title: Deere Launches AI Assistant Named JD to Guide Farmers’ Choices
news_candidates.title_zh: 迪尔推出名为JD的AI助手，帮助农民作出选择
news_candidates.summary: Farmers are getting some help sorting through the reams of data collected by their high-tech tractors: An AI assistant named JD built into Deere & Co.’s Operations Center mobile application.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 农民可借助内置于迪尔公司Operations Center移动应用的AI助手JD，整理高科技拖拉机收集的大量数据。

news_candidates.title: Russian Steel Demand Revives as War Damage Drives Construction
news_candidates.title_zh: 战争破坏带动建设，俄罗斯钢铁需求复苏
news_candidates.summary: Russian steelmakers are seeing signs of a recovery in domestic demand and prices as delayed construction projects resume and repairs to assets damaged by Ukrainian attacks help drive a revival.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 随着延迟的建筑项目恢复，以及修复遭乌克兰袭击破坏的资产，俄罗斯钢铁企业看到国内需求和价格复苏的迹象。

news_candidates.title: Baidu’s AI Profits to Match Those From Search Soon, CFO Says
news_candidates.title_zh: 百度CFO称AI利润不久将媲美搜索业务
news_candidates.summary: Baidu Inc.’s finance chief said the company’s investment in AI could soon generate profits and cash payback on par with those of its legacy search business, justifying a hard-fought transition from its internet roots.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 百度财务负责人表示，公司对人工智能的投资可能很快产生与传统搜索业务相当的利润和现金回报，为其艰难推进的互联网业务转型提供依据。

news_candidates.title: Shein’s Debut Shows the Cost of IPO Missing Its Growth Peak
news_candidates.title_zh: Shein上市显示错过增长高峰的代价
news_candidates.summary: Shein Global Holdings Ltd.’s shares long-awaited market debut has come at an awkward time: the fast-fashion retailer’s peak growth years are behind it just as tariffs, regulatory pressure and intensifying competition are making its next phase harder.
news_candidates.summary_zh: Shein的长期等待上市恰逢尴尬时点：这家快时尚零售商的增长高峰已过，而关税、监管压力和加剧的竞争令其下一阶段更为艰难。

news_candidates.title: Asia Data Center Debt Binge Hitting Banks’ Limits, Barclays Says
news_candidates.title_zh: 巴克莱称亚洲数据中心融资热潮触及银行承受极限
news_candidates.summary: The billions of dollars being borrowed to fund data centers in Asia are pushing banks to their limits and making them more selective about which projects to finance, according to senior bankers at Barclays Plc.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 巴克莱高级银行家称，为亚洲数据中心融资而借入的数十亿美元正将银行推向承受极限，并使其更谨慎地选择融资项目。

news_candidates.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 1
news_candidates.title_zh: 美伊新一轮敌对行动冲击霍尔木兹海峡原油运输
news_candidates.summary: Oil rose for a second session as fresh hostilities between the US and Iran raised concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz, where crude carriers were hit by projectiles.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 美伊敌对行动加剧后，霍尔木兹海峡附近原油运输面临延续性中断担忧；报道称有油轮遭投射物击中，油价连续第二日上涨。

news_candidates.title: Indian LNG Imports Surge to Six-Year High Even as Prices Spike
news_candidates.title_zh: 尽管价格飙升，印度LNG进口升至近六年高点
news_candidates.summary: India’s liquefied natural gas imports jumped in August to the highest in nearly six years, defying higher spot prices as fertilizer and fuel distributors sought to replace shipments disrupted by the Iran war.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度8月液化天然气进口升至近六年高点。尽管现货价格上涨，化肥和燃料分销商仍寻求替代因伊朗战争受扰的货运。

news_candidates.title: India’s Economy Grows Faster Than Expected at 7.8%
news_candidates.title_zh: 印度经济增速超预期，达7.8%
news_candidates.summary: India’s economy grew faster than expected in the last quarter, defying the energy shock from the Iran war. Ruchi Bhatia explains what’s powering the growth and what could come next. (Source: Bloomberg)
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度经济上季度增长7.8%，快于预期，并抵御了伊朗战争造成的能源冲击。报道探讨了推动增长的因素及后续可能走势。

news_candidates.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi asks Putin to end Ukraine war amid U.S. tariff threat on Russian oil
news_candidates.title_zh: 印度总理莫迪在美国对俄石油加征关税威胁下要求普京结束乌战
news_candidates.summary: Indian PM Narendra Modi has urged Russia to end the Ukraine war and to cease hostilities.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪敦促俄罗斯结束乌克兰战争并停止敌对行动。

news_candidates.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
news_candidates.title_zh: 报道称贝森特告知俄罗斯：乌战结束前不会获得经济缓解
news_candidates.summary: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.
news_candidates.summary_zh: 据报道，贝森特表示，在乌克兰战争结束前，俄罗斯不会获得经济缓解。G20会议凸显华盛顿愿重启与莫斯科的外交对话，而欧洲计划在战争持续期间孤立俄罗斯。
